models.name: XGBoost Baseline
models.notes: Balanced via scale_pos_weight, base feature set (amount, SQL features, V1-V28).

models.name: XGBoost + Graph Features (Final)
models.notes: Adds degree_centrality and community_size graph features. Highest PR-AUC of any model, but not used in production: graph features require a full recomputation of the card-merchant network and are impractical to compute per-request. The baseline (2.0.0) is served instead.

models.name: Ensemble (XGBoost + Autoencoder)
models.notes: Adding the autoencoder did not improve PR-AUC (see Week 5 analysis). Not promoted to production.
